sv.title: Officer misstänks för brott mot landets säkerhet
sv.summary: En officer vid Sveriges försvarsmakt utreds av Säpo för grov obehörig befattning med hemlig uppgift, skriver DN. Den misstänkta brottsligheten ska ha ägt rum under 2025.

en.title: Officer suspected of crimes against the country's security
en.summary: An officer with the Swedish Armed Forces is being investigated by Säpo for gross unauthorised handling of classified information, DN reports. The suspected crime is said to have taken place in 2025.
